# Firebean Agency
> Hong Kong's dedicated lifestyle PR agency specialising in government department campaigns, roving exhibitions, and public engagement events since 2007.

## About Firebean
Firebean Limited is a professional Lifestyle PR and Event Production agency headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong. Since 2007, we have delivered over 360 projects, engaging more than 1.5 million people across Hong Kong and the Asia-Pacific region.

Today, we go "All-In" on government projects. By "Turning Policy into Play," we transform serious public affairs into engaging, human-centred campaigns. This bold strategy brought lifestyle vibrancy to the public sector, leading to our appointment as the Official PR Consultant for the Buildings Department in 2023.

## Government & Public Sector Expertise
With over 50% of our portfolio serving Hong Kong government bureaus, Firebean is the agency of record for constitutional education, anti-drug outreach, electoral engagement, and public health campaigns.

Key government clients include:
- Constitutional and Mainland Affairs Bureau (政制及內地事務局)
- Security Bureau & Narcotics Division (保安局禁毒處)
- Education Bureau (教育局)
- Buildings Department (屋宇署)
- Housing Authority (房屋署)
- Civil Service Bureau (公務員事務局)
- Department of Justice (律政司)
- Leisure and Cultural Services Department (康文署)

## Core Services
- Roving Exhibitions: Travelling public engagement exhibitions for government and brands
- Social & Content: Social media strategy, content creation, and community management
- Interactive & Tech: Interactive installations, digital activations, and tech-driven experiences
- PR & Media: Media relations, press management, and earned media campaigns
- Events & Ceremonies: Full-scale event production, opening ceremonies, and brand activations
